name: Of Coursers We Know
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The mosshoof coursers of Azshara are magnificent animals who once lived in Felwood.  They naturally resist disease and poison, and were unaffected by the corruption there.  In their ancestral wisdom, they simply chose to leave that sickened place.

It saddens my heart, but I must ask you to hunt these mighty beasts for me.  Gather four courser glands as the first ingredient for a restorative salve -- a salve we will use to heal Felwood.
narrative.objectives: Acquire 4 Healthy Courser Glands and bring them to Ogtinc in Azshara.  Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
narrative.offerRewardText:
It is good the divine path has led you to us, adventurer. Your beliefs do not interfere with the tasks involved in creating this salve.

You see, the courser is sacred to the Cenarion Circle, and killing them for any reason, no matter how necessary, weakens their spirit.
narrative.requestItemsText: You have returned. Were you successful?
